manifest.name: ORCH-µ
manifest.description: Orchestration micronaut — relational routing, call dispatch, composition planning, knowledge-gap routing. Routes resolved requests to target micronauts via Ch'en phase dispatch. proposal_only: does not execute calls; emits a typed dispatch proposal for XCFE.

orch.route.description: Pop/Wo-phase: select target micronaut from governs registry — matches input against track governs lists, returns ranked target candidates with confidence scores.

orch.plan.description: Wo/Yax-phase: compose a multi-step dispatch plan from a request — decomposes into ordered call sequence, identifies dependency chain between target micronauts.

orch.dispatch.description: Ch'en-phase: emit xcfe-gated dispatch call proposal to selected target micronaut — includes target ID, input text, expected phase, and authority chain. XCFE must admit before execution.

orch.verify.description: Ch'en/Xul-phase: verify result returned from dispatched micronaut — checks response schema, authority claim, and xcfe_admitted status.

orch.health.description: Pop-phase: reports registered target micronauts, dispatch queue status, last route proposal, xcfe gate status.
